CyaCE

It took me several hours of searching to locate the original version at : ftp://cvsftp.cotw.com/Nino/bootloaders/cyace/cyace.tar.bz2

# | 23.32 | Filip | No comments yet

pbsdboot

This is part of the NetBSD source tree, so I got it from the NetBSD cvs:
export CVSROOT=:pserver:anoncvs@anoncvs.netbsd.org:/cvsroot
cvs login (passwd: anoncvs)
cvs co syssrc/
And then open syssrc/sys/arch/hpcmips/stand/pbsdboot with MS eMbedded Visual C.
